subject: Important Information Regarding Your Recent Booking
body: Dear [Recipient], We are writing to inform you about a change in the schedule of your upcoming flight from New York to London. Due to unforeseen circumstances, the departure time has been shifted to 2 hours earlier. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Please review the updated details in your booking confirmation email. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. Thank you for choosing our airline. Safe travels! Best regards, The Flight Company Team
